The UnixLib build definition emits .so-named targets and links rt. Host implementation, replacement requirements and source coverage are not assessed in Stage 1.

ARM64EC CI uses a Wine 11.2-labelled binary input, an LLVM-MinGW 20260908-labelled compiler bundle, and separately built ARM64 Darwin LLVM 15.0.7 libraries. Acquired source candidates do not establish binary provenance or mutual ABI compatibility.
winemetal build rules require Wine build/install libraries and winebuild. Copying isolated DLLs is not established as a compatible integration path.

DXMT declares C++20, a Metal shader compilation target, LLVM libraries and native math/zlib/curses/XML link inputs; a Homebrew-prefix branch adds zstd/libunwind. Exact SDK and tool/runtime library closure remains unresolved.

The source-build defaults select LLVM 23.1.1 and an exact MinGW-w64 commit. The workflow can replace versions for scheduled/manual runs. The uninspected binary bundle and its release build parameters are not authenticated by acquiring these source defaults.
